frame.axes: x east, y up, z = -north (plan y); the journey runs toward +x; Lowlight Mooring at the origin, the Quay's decks at y = 124.8 to 131.2
frame.rotation: rot_y_deg is a yaw about +y (counter-clockwise seen from above); quat = [x, y, z, w] is the full rotation
frame.scale: [sx, sy, sz] in the asset's own axes
frame.front: a building's front (shop side) is the GLB's +z; at rot_y_deg = 0 it faces world +z (south)

tint_doc: tint maps a light-role material of the instance to a palette key; roles not listed use defaults: {"win_warm": "win_d", "win_cool": "win_a", "win_stair": "win_a", "strip": "eave", "beacon": "beacon", "landmark": "landmark", "garden": "garden_a", "lantern": "amber", "keel": "bounce_a", "neon_a": "sign_a", "beam_lamp": "moon_disc", "cond_glow": "cond_a", "cond_lamp": "cond_a", "cond_work": "cond_c"}

camera.note: the 70.2 s journey; it12 (owner msg 149): from the Quay's close pass (35.75 s) faster down the Quay, then slow (7-8 m/s) and low over the band's plaza 44.4-46.25 s with the band ahead-right at 14-24 m, up into the Veil at 47.0 s as before; `look_ahead` (m along the path, keyed) shortens to 16 m over the plaza so the lens keeps looking where it travels, not up into the Veil; it11's opening and end as before

band.note: it12 (owner msg 149): the band on a round stage where the garden's pool was. The stage, terrace and fixtures are kit instances (zone 'band'); this block is what the engine places and drives: the two astronaut musicians (gitignored GLBs from the main checkout, never committed; each with its props on one transform), the floor spots as spot lights, the halo's four searchlights as cloud beams, the audio intent.

audio.drums: the drummer's clip on the song's beat (171.4 BPM); the Drums clip is 4.7 s
audio.keys: the pianist on the Moog/pad phrases
audio.floor_spots: kick: +60 % 15/250 ms; the four colours swap on each crash (a quarter turn of the key order)
audio.sky_beams: sway +-12 deg in yaw over two bars, whip with the lighthouses on the crashes; snare: +40 % 10/180 ms
audio.halo: the halo's lanterns chase round the ring on the hats (the kit's lantern role already chases on hh)
audio.stage_ring: the inlaid ring (strip) on the bass; the footlights on the toms
audio.held_breath: 45.5-47.15 s: the floor spots dim to 30 %, the sky beams hold still; all back on the 47.15 s crash
